args.title: Parse quoted header columns correctly in statement ingest
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields instead of split(",") when parsing the CSV header line so that quoted column names are correctly parsed and stripped of quotes, matching how transaction rows are processed.

args.message: Use splitFields for header parsing to support quoted column names

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The header line was parsed using a simple split(',') rather than splitFields, causing quoted column names to retain their quotes and fail validation against required columns.
